title: Colorful stuff
description: Resource pack that adds a couple of textures similar to 'Actions & stuff'
body: ![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/767fe43a704d89da8c12444fa807bae385c320d1_0.webp)![Block variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c30ce1df541e4c7aa20f6ccb2dc86821721724d_0.webp)![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/457bbf60ffeffef633dd7abaa7a786536512aba0_0.webp)You’ve likely noticed, when watching Bedrock gameplay featuring the "Actions & Stuff" texture pack, that the world was full of color and vibrancy. Well, this texture pack adds a couple of blocks similar to "Actions & Stuff."
